text: I should not quote a decline rate from memory. Finding the paper first.
Trotter et al. 2017 looks like the source. Fetching the abstract rather than attributing a figure to it unread.

The figure comes from Trotter et al. 2017 (2017MNRAS.469.1299T). Its abstract gives a secular decline of 0.670 +/- 0.019 per cent per year at 1.4 GHz, averaged over six decades. The paper is explicit that the decline is not constant -- it varies with epoch and with frequency -- so the number only means anything quoted with that averaging interval and that observing frequency.
